decisions.why: Laboratory analytical equipment including digital dispensers (D300e), automated liquid handlers (Fluent, Freedom EVO), and plate readers (Spark Cyto) for pathology/laboratory analysis

Spans orthopaedic equipment (Ossatec Bone Growth Stimulator), upper-limb support devices (Actimove Sling and Comfort Sling for shoulder/arm support), and paediatric orthotics (Paediatric Wrist Splint)
Endoscopy equipment including colonoscopes, bronchoscopes, and capsule endoscopy systems (examples: FLAMINGO, OCTOPUS, MANTA); general endoscopy consumables
Patient handling products including Molift slings and hoists for transfer aids, plus bed and seating solutions (Stargazer Seating and Sleeping Solution) for residential care facilities
Advanced wound dressings (Sorbion Sachet, Cutimed range) including alginate and DACC dressings, plus film and post-operative dressings
Respiratory therapy products including aerosol therapy (Portable Compressor Nebuliser), endotracheal tube management, non-invasive ventilation systems (AirLife), and airway clearance devices (Vest)
Interventional radiology devices including aspiration catheters for thrombectomy (BigLumen) and embolic agents for vascular ablation (Magic Glue, Squidperi)
Surgical gloves exclusively (Protexis™ Latex and Neoprene variants in standard, ortho, and micro sizes)
General theatre consumables including wound protectors, retractors, suction and irrigation sets; specimen retrieval systems (ELABAG)
Spans enteral feeding (Kangaroo pump and giving sets), general vascular needles (Monoject blunt fill), and haemodialysis catheters (MAHURKAR)
JOBST compression products spanning wound care (UlcerCARE for ulcer management) and general compression hosiery (Confidence, Ultrasheer, Relax)
Surgical products including general theatre suction/instruments (Medina Suction) and minimally invasive energy-based ablation (Aquablation Therapy for BPH)
Cardiothoracic surgical consumables including haemostats (GENTA-COLL, PuraBond), anastomosis assist devices, and valve exposure systems
Mobility aids and rehabilitation equipment (EZ Rider, Gazelle, Meerkat, Cricket product lines) for patient mobilisation and rehabilitation
Oesophageal stents exclusively (TTS, S Type covered/uncovered, Mega, Double Oesophageal Stents)
Urological stents including urethral and ureteral stents (Uventra, Uventa brands)
Compression bandages and therapeutic wraps (JOBST Tensopress, Opaque, Comprilan, Comprifore)
Vascular stents and filters (Luminor, Oceanus product names suggest venous stent/filter systems)
Biliary stents for hepatobiliary intervention (S Type, S Biliary covered/uncovered, LCD Biliary Stents)
Standing and fall recovery aids (Raizer system with wall brackets, trolleys, and carry cases for assisted standing)
Cardiac devices including embolic protection (FLOWer), and cardiac thrombectomy systems (AngioVac Cannula & Circuit for aspiration)
Antimicrobial wound dressings (Cutimed Sorbact, Leukomed Sorbact, Telfa AMD) with silver or DACC technology
Clinical furniture including comfort chairs and loungers (Pride C15 Cameo, 660 Dual Motor Mini Lounger) for care facilities
Patient monitoring equipment including pulse oximetry systems (Nellcor PM100N), temperature monitoring (Genius tympanic thermometer)
Powered wheelchairs and scooters (Sunrise Quickie 200R, Magic Mobility 4×4 outdoor wheelchair)
Sterilisation and decontamination equipment including heatsealers (Hawo), instrument washers and sterilisers (Belimed)
Enteral stents for GI management (D Type, Comvi stent systems)
Gynaecological minimally invasive surgery including endometrial ablation (NovaSure), uterine manipulation (RUMI II System)
General PPE including disposable aprons (Shermond), disinfectant wipes (Alcowipes), and nitrile examination gloves
Interventional radiology capital equipment including microwave ablation (Solero) and irreversible electroporation (NanoKnife) systems
Manual wheelchairs (Sunrise Nitrum, Sunrise Quickie LIFE wheelchair product lines)
Endoscopic ultrasound-guided stents for biliary and pancreatic drainage (Nagi, SPAXUS stent systems)
Highly absorbent advanced dressings for exudate management (Cutimed Siltec, Cutimed Cavity)
Endoscopic ultrasound transducers and probes (SU-1 system, EUS Sonoprobe) for diagnostic and therapeutic EUS
Gastroenterology ablation including endoscopic ultrasound radiofrequency ablation (EUSRA, ELRA) for biliary/pancreatic lesions
Bathing and showering aids (Freeway Shower Chairs, Freeway Shower Trolleys)
Patient warming and temperature management devices (Mon-a-therm temperature probes, Celsius forced air warming system)
Surgical gloves (Protexis PI Micro Surgical Gloves)
Lower GI endoscopy equipment including colonoscopy systems (ELUXEO 7000 Series)
Pulmonary endoscopy equipment (Bronchoscopy System)
Pressure relief equipment (Vicair Strap Back pressure relief positioning aids)
Tracheostomy/bronchoscopy device (Comvi Trach Bronch stent system) for airway management
Neuromuscular blockade monitoring for anaesthesia (TetraGraph train-of-four monitoring device)
Arterial intervention devices including repositionable vascular stents (sinus-Repo-Visual)
Vascular imaging diagnostic equipment (Mizuho Vascular Doppler Systems for vascular assessment)
Examination and treatment couches (Medi-Plinth) for clinical facilities
Comfort seating for care facilities (Careflex comfort chairs)
Vascular access connector systems (SecurePortIV port system)
